## Not guaranteed

Everything tagged "appearance, approximate" in the part, and every illustration choice. It is shown for looks only and is not checked against a catalogue dimension:

- Corner radii of the compact flange (the figures show rounded corners without a dimension; drawn as W / 4)
- Rotation of the set screw holes about the shaft axis (only the 90 degree spacing and the axial position are in the figure); the long sleeve D16 and up draw both stations at the same angles
- The square flange cut corners: K is read as the side of the square and H as the extent across the cut corners (tip to tip along the hole axes); the size of the cut is derived from the two
- No chamfers or fillets on the sleeve, the bore floor (R, E-STHX) or the flange edges, and the chamfering of E-STHX (none dimensioned); the screws themselves, the hex socket head cap screws supplied with the slit and compact clamp types are not modelled
- Surface treatment: black oxide film (B types), electroless nickel plating, stainless steel are given as printed, not modelled
- Which D the not-applicable notes exclude (E-STHS D6, E-STHR D15, E-SSTHC D50; E-STHRN D8 / D35, E-STHCN D10, E-STHRBN D35; E-STHXRB D8; E-STHMRBL D25; E-SSTHWR D35, E-SSTHWS D40 / D50, E-SSTHWSL D12) is taken literally from the page note and applied to the named type only (the long sleeve variants of a thickened type are not excluded)
- Slit and clamp types (E-STHW.., E-STHMR..): the depth of the groove (S1 / S wide, z printed) is not dimensioned, read from the figure as the cut from the top down to the bottom of the shaft bore; the radial slit is drawn over the ring length B only, from the shaft axis up through the outside on +Y (the stub below the bore in the figure and the slit width of the E-STHMR figure, 1.5 mm, are read from the drawing); the clamp screw (two at B / 4 and 3 B / 4 on the slit long sleeve, as in its figure) is on +Y at height X, clearance hole and counterbore on -X, tapped hole on +X (the side is read from the figure)
- E-STHMR: the counterbore depth of the two mounting holes (diameter d2 printed) is not printed: drawn B deep from the clamp end (appearance, approximate); the H tolerance 0 / -0.2 is not modelled
- E-STHMR figure reading: T (T1 for the long sleeve) is the thickness of the part before the groove, S the groove width and B the ring; L = T + S + B holds for every row of the table
- Thickness (N): printed, and equal to (D1 - D) / 2 in every row of every table; checked as the sleeve wall, not modelled as a separate feature
- Set screw position l (standard) is measured from the flange face opposite the sleeve (z = 0; the extension line of l ends on the same face as L and T), release 0.1.0 had added T to l, corrected here; long sleeve l1 likewise, D16 and up at l1 and 2 x l1
- Load ratings, masses and the O.D. comparison table of p.532 are not modelled
